senses.gloss:
ind. Thus, so, in this manner; इत्थं रतेः किमपि भूतमद्दश्यरूपम् [[Ku. 4. 45]]; इत्थंगते under these circumstances, such being the case; इत्थंगते किमस्माभिः करणीयम् [[Ś. 4]]; [[R. 9. 81.]] 
-Comp. 
-कारम् ind. in this manner. 
-भूत a. 
__1 so circumstanced, being in this state, being thus; °आख्याने [[P. I. 4. 90]]; [[Me. 96]]; [[Ku. 6. 26]]; [[Ś. 3. 5]]; कथमित्थंभूता [[M. 5]], [[K. 146.]] 
__2 true or faithful (as a story). 
-भावः being thus endowed, having these qualities. 
-विध a. 
__1 of such kind. 
__2 endowed with such qualities.
N. of the third Yoga in Astronomy (Arabic origin).

ind. Ved. 
__1 In this manner, thus; क इत्थावेद यत्र सः [[Kaṭh. 1. 2. 24.]] 
__2 A particle of affirmation used to lay stress on a following word, indeed. 
__3 Truly, really. °घी a. performing such or true works.
